Definition: to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily
BiblicalUsage: 1) to speak rashly or angrily, speak thoughtlessly; 1a) (Qal) one that babbles, speaks rashly (part.); 1b) (Piel) to speak rashly, unadvisedly
